question: What comprehensive division of eightfold groups is sought to be fully known?
premises: There is a division into groups of eight times eight
The speaker seeks full knowledge of this division
The knowledge is sought in an exhaustive manner
inference: The speaker seeks to fully know the division of the sixty-four groups.
uncertainties: anantathā may mean endlessly or in infinite detail
plain_english: I wish to fully know the division of the eight groups of eight, in all its extent.
